annotation.title_clean: CDEI publishes its first series of three snapshot papers on ethical issues in AI
annotation.title_en: CDEI publishes its first series of three snapshot papers on ethical issues in AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation
annotation.summary_en: GOV.UK page announcing the UK Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation's first three snapshot briefing papers on AI ethics: deepfakes, AI in personal insurance, and smart speakers. It explains the snapshot format and lists forthcoming CDEI work on facial recognition, micro-targeting and algorithmic bias.
key_provisions_or_claims: First three CDEI snapshots cover deepfakes, AI in personal insurance and smart speakers.
Snapshots are briefing papers outlining risks, ethical issues and possible government and industry actions.
Topics were chosen by CDEI's independent Board based on public concern.
Further work planned: facial recognition, data sharing frameworks, online micro-targeting and algorithmic bias recommendations.
